newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Dailey Petroleum Q4 net loss.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Dailey Petroleum Q4 net loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: The company said its 1997 fiscal year ended April 30.
The average shares outstanding for the fourth quarter of 1997 were 9,291,000, as compared with a pro forma 6,610,000 for the prior year.
The average shares outstanding for fiscal 1997 were 8,060,000, as compared with a pro forma 6,610,000 for the prior year.
Earnings per share and average shares outstanding for the fourth quarter and fiscal 1996 are pro forma results because of the company's initial public offering in August 1996.
The company's fiscal 1997 results do not give effect to its previously announced acquisition of Air Drilling International Inc, which occurred in June 1997.

Net income and earnings per share for fiscal reflected a non-cash, after tax charge of $1.7 million related to the accelerated vesting of stock awards granted in conjunction with Dailey's initial public offering.

Net income for the fouth quarter of 1997 reflected a non-cash, after tax charge of $1.3 million related to the accelerated vesting of stock awards granted in conjunction with Dailey's initial public offering.
